_readme: Calibration sets (COLLECTION.md §4) for Cherry Ventures, pre-registered 2026-09-04 BEFORE the base build (PRO-73 Phase 1).

`membership` is the trap set: 18 falses (network-founder companies the site presents beside the team, string and namesake traps, the acquirers the site lists under their own name, LP and feeder vehicles, the founders' pre-Cherry companies, unnamed stealth placeholders) and 16 trues across eras and surfaces (archive-only 2016-2019 listings, a 2019-only listing later replaced by its acquirer, Sanity/job-board-only rows, Decentral token positions with press corroboration). Gate: zero false members at high confidence; structural falses must have NO published base row; the two listed acquirers must be judged not_member.

`stage` is the entry-stage key: every row anchored to a document naming the round and Cherry's participation — the firm's own posts (Webflow news, the Sanity article store, the archived WordPress posts and their Common Crawl records), or press where the firm's post names no round. The 2016-2019 site's own 'Investment: Seed / Series A' label and the archived listing dates are LAYERS scored against this key, never the key.
